name: Asynchronous Pipeline (Overlap)
aliases: Concurrent SSD Read and GPU Rendering
definition: A pipelining strategy that overlaps SSD read/prefetch, H2D staging, and GPU rendering/backpropagation to hide I/O latency.
summary: Asynchronous Pipeline overlaps SSD reads, data transfers, and GPU rendering using multi-threading to hide I/O latency, allowing rendering to proceed while data is fetched.
